plan.summary: FEAT-PROJELER slice S2: projects CRUD in Invekto.Outbound over the inert S1 schema (projects + project_targets). Adds ProjectsRepository (raw Npgsql, tenant-scoped, transactional set-based targets, soft-delete-as-archive), ProjectsService (gating + validation, tuple returns), 5 minimal-API endpoints /api/v1/projects, ProjectDtos in Shared, ProjectsOptions feature gate, and the INV-OB-066..071 error block. Metadata only — no send path, no cxapi config write, no counter recompute (PR-4).
plan.q_intent: Continue PKT-14 Projeler after S1 (schema). Proceed with S2 — projects CRUD on the data_lists slice pattern (DataListRepository / Program.cs as template). 5 endpoints /api/v1/projects, ProjectsRepository + ProjectsService + ProjectDtos + INV-OB-066+; register endpoint DI services unconditionally + [FromServices] (RDF lesson). Send action stays inert until PR-4 + gate lift.
plan.interview_notes: Decisions (AskUserQuestion 2026-06-07): (1) project_targets handled set-based, EMBEDDED in create/update body (data_list_id[] replaced in the same tx) -> 5 endpoints, matches the S4 wizard flow; (2) gating = a NEW ProjectsOptions mirroring ContactListOptions (Enabled + AllowAllTenants + allowlist), default OFF in code, prod config decided by Q at deploy; (3) the cxapi config columns (instance_id/template_kind/wa_template_id/template_language/param_mapping) are DEFERRED to PR-4 — S2 writes only name/description/targets and archive. Backend proxy routes + React UI are S4 (data_lists GR4 precedent).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Projects CRUD is gated by a NEW ProjectsOptions (Enabled + AllowedTenantIds + AllowAllTenants), mirroring ContactListOptions, instead of reusing the ContactList gate or shipping ungated.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q interview decision. Managing a project is metadata-only and never dispatches a message, so it warrants its own kill-switch; the same pilot-allowlist shape keeps one ops mental model. The SEND path stays independently gated (CxapiSend/BulkSend) + the P0-3 live-enablement gate, so opening Projects never enables a send.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED separate options class, NOT duplicate gating. This mirrors the established ContactListOptions/BulkSendOptions/ExportOptions per-feature-flag precedent in the same Program.cs. Default OFF (Enabled=false) is production-safe. Not over-engineering.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: The project-level cxapi send config columns (instance_id/template_kind/wa_template_id/template_language/param_mapping) and the denormalized run counters (run/total_targets/sent/delivered/read/failed/ambiguous) are NOT written by S2 — they stay inert at their migration defaults.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: S2 is metadata CRUD. PR-4 owns the approved-template send wiring + the authoritative counter recompute (recomputed after each run, never per-row), exactly as migration 057 reserved them and as PR-1 deferred the bulk_send_jobs cxapi columns to their owning PR (CQ11 precedent). Writing them now would create a half-built send config behind the P0-3 gate.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED inert columns with no S2 writer. Counters are surfaced in the DTO (stable contract) but read as 0; cxapi config is intentionally absent from the DTOs/CRUD. Not a missing-write bug or dead schema — PR-4 is the writer.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Target list ids are validated with an explicit in-transaction SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) ... WHERE deleted_at IS NULL pre-check (returns INV-OB-070) rather than relying on catching the project_targets -> data_lists FK violation.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: A clean 422 with an actionable message beats a caught constraint error; more importantly, data_lists uses soft-delete (deleted_at), so the composite FK alone would still accept a soft-deleted list (its row persists). The pre-check excludes deleted lists; the composite (tenant_id, data_list_id) FK remains the structural cross-tenant backstop.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED pre-check + FK backstop together. The pre-check is not redundant with the FK — it is the only thing that rejects soft-deleted lists and produces a clean code. Cross-tenant is still impossible at the DB level via the composite FK.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: The new /api/v1/projects endpoints carry explicit [FromServices] on their ProjectsService param, even though the sibling /api/v1/data-lists endpoints in the same file omit it.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Belt-and-suspenders for the 2026-05-27 .NET 8 RDF startup-crash incident (unregistered complex param on a GET/DELETE endpoint mis-inferred as a body -> startup crash). The services are ALSO registered unconditionally (the actual fix); [FromServices] is the secondary guard the lesson recommends. Not refactoring the existing data-lists endpoints is in-scope discipline.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED [FromServices] on new endpoints; the data-lists divergence is intentional (defensive improvement, not a bug). Unconditional AddSingleton registration is the primary RDF guard; both are present.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id} performs a soft-delete-as-archive (status='archived' + archived_at) and returns {id, archived:true}; GET excludes archived projects.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: bulk_send_jobs.project_id is ON DELETE RESTRICT, so a project with runs cannot be hard-deleted; archive is the delete semantics. archived_at frees the active name (partial-unique index WHERE archived_at IS NULL) and preserves the row + counters for reconciliation, mirroring the sibling data_lists.deleted_at convention.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED archive-on-DELETE, not a hard DELETE. Consistent with the S1 soft-delete-as-archive design and the data_lists soft-delete precedent. Returning archived:true (not deleted:true) is deliberate and honest.

verification_questions.question: Are Create and Update atomic so a project can never persist with a partial target set, and are target list ids that are missing, not owned by the tenant, or soft-deleted rejected BEFORE any project/target row is written (INV-OB-070), with the composite FK as the cross-tenant backstop?

Is every endpoint tenant-scoped (TenantContext.TenantId in every query, TenantContext.UserId -> created_by) and gated by ProjectsOptions, so one tenant can never list, read, update, or archive another tenant's project or attach another tenant's data_list?

Does DELETE archive (soft-delete) instead of hard-deleting — respecting the bulk_send_jobs.project_id ON DELETE RESTRICT FK — and does archiving free the active name (partial-unique WHERE archived_at IS NULL) while GET list/detail exclude archived rows?

Is S2 genuinely send-path-independent — no cxapi config column or run counter is written, no tenant is allowlisted, the P0-3 live-enablement gate and the bulk engine are untouched — with the cxapi columns deliberately deferred to PR-4?

Are all DB failures typed NpgsqlException catches mapped to distinct INV-OB codes (no catch(Exception), no silent failure path), and is the COUNT(*) target_count cast to ::int so the int reader never hits a bigint cast error?

projects cxapi send columns (instance_id/template_kind/wa_template_id/template_language/param_mapping) — PR-4 owns the writer
The bulk send engine (BulkSend/Broadcast orchestrators, MessageSenderService) and outbound_messages/outbound_broadcasts
bulk_send_jobs.project_id population / run linking / counter recompute (wired when runs dispatch in PR-4)
arch/db/** (no schema change in S2; the migration was S1)

No automated tests added (project convention: tests only when requested)

try_catch_locations: ProjectsRepository.CreateAsync/UpdateAsync — catch (PostgresException UniqueViolation) -> NameConflict (rollback); other NpgsqlException propagates and `await using` tx disposal rolls back
user_facing_errors: INV-OB-066 Projeler bu hesap için etkin değil.
INV-OB-067 Proje bilgisi geçersiz. Ad ve seçilen listeleri kontrol edin.
INV-OB-069 Bu isimde bir proje zaten var. Farklı bir ad girin.
INV-OB-070 Seçilen listelerden biri bulunamadı. Liste seçimini güncelleyin.
INV-OB-071 Veritabanı hatası nedeniyle işlem tamamlanamadı. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every DB path is a typed NpgsqlException catch returning a distinct INV-OB code (no catch(Exception), no swallow). Create/Update are transactional: a unique-name collision or invalid target rolls back and returns a specific code; any other DB error propagates to the service catch and the `await using` transaction disposal rolls back (no half-built project). Validation failures return actionable codes before touching the DB.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operators rebuild the same audience selection every campaign and have no way to save 'who + which lists' as a reusable unit.
aha_moments.suggestion: Create a named project once with its target lists; the GET detail returns each list with its live sendable_count so the operator sees the projected audience at a glance.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the operator opens a saved project and instantly sees 'Yaz Kampanyası → 3 liste, 4.812 gönderilebilir' instead of re-picking lists from scratch.

aha_moments.user_pain: A blast tool that lets you attach the wrong tenant's list — or a deleted list — is a data-leak / dead-send waiting to happen.
aha_moments.suggestion: Targets are validated in-transaction against the tenant's active (non-deleted) lists before any write, with the composite (tenant_id, data_list_id) FK as a structural backstop.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When selecting a since-deleted list cleanly fails with 'Seçilen listelerden biri bulunamadı' instead of silently creating a project that can never send.

aha_moments.user_pain: Deleting a finished project would destroy the run history finance/support need for reconciliation.
aha_moments.suggestion: DELETE archives (soft-delete) rather than hard-deleting; the ON DELETE RESTRICT FK guarantees a project with runs can never be erased, and the name is freed for reuse.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When support reuses an old project name for a new campaign while the archived original (and its counters) stays intact for an audit months later.

aha_moments.user_pain: Editing a project's list selection one-add/one-remove-at-a-time is tedious and error-prone for the operator.
aha_moments.suggestion: PUT replaces the whole target set in a single atomic call (deduped, order-preserved); the wizard just sends the final list of ids.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When reordering/swapping lists in the S4 wizard saves in one click with the new order preserved, no partial state.

aha_moments.user_pain: A new feature that silently swallows DB errors leaves operators staring at a spinner with no idea whether their project saved.
aha_moments.suggestion: Distinct INV-OB-066..071 codes (403/400/404/409/422/503) map each failure class to an actionable Turkish message; transient DB errors are 503-retryable and never leave a half-built project.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a momentary DB hiccup returns a clear 'tekrar deneyin' and the retry just works, with nothing half-saved.

aha_moments.user_pain: Prospects ask whether Invekto supports repeatable, list-targeted WhatsApp campaigns (TONIVA mode4 parity), and a one-off CSV blast doesn't demo well.
aha_moments.suggestion: The projects CRUD layer is the operator-facing foundation that turns saved lists into named, reusable campaigns — the API the S4 'Projeler' page drives.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When sales demos creating a 'Proje', attaching saved lists, and seeing the audience size — the repeatable-campaign story lands before send is even enabled.

verdict.raw_text: Codex (mcp__codex-review__codex_review, model gpt-5.5-2026-04-23) iteration 4: OVERALL PASS. Code Quality Gate 12/12 PASS (CQ1-CQ12), CoVe 5/5 PASS (Q1-Q5), 0 blocking. Grind: iter0 FAIL (5: validation-order, name! null-forgiving, generic disabled-msg) -> iter1 FAIL (4: post-commit-reload mislabels INV-OB-071, silent non-positive id drop, soft-delete race, schema-evidence) -> iter2 FAIL (1: race not fully closed) -> iter3 FAIL (1: INV-OB-071 commit-ambiguity overclaim) -> iter4 PASS. Final design: tenant-scoped raw-Npgsql CRUD; create/update transactional with FOR SHARE target row-lock (closes soft-delete TOCTOU) + validating INSERT + count check; in-tx LoadDetailAsync (no post-commit reload); typed NpgsqlException -> INV-OB-071 (commit-ambiguity documented, retry-safe via unique-name guard + idempotency); soft-delete-as-archive; ProjectsOptions gate default-OFF; cxapi columns/run counters deferred to PR-4.

CQ1.evidence: Typed NpgsqlException catches -> specific INV-OB codes; Program.cs ProjectStatus/ProjectMessage map to HTTP + Turkish messages; arch/errors.md documents INV-OB-066..071.

CQ2.evidence: No bare catch(Exception); non-positive target ids rejected (not dropped); explicit failure-flag results.

CQ3.evidence: Diff scope = declared S2 CRUD files only; no send-engine/cxapi/allowlist changes.

CQ4.evidence: Service-local repository pattern; intentional per-feature gate mirrors ContactListOptions.

CQ5.evidence: snake_case SQL, parameterized NpgsqlCommand, await using disposal, no null-forgiving operator, unconditional DI registration.

CQ6.evidence: Set-based validation (FOR SHARE) + unnest insert; no N+1; bounded by MaxTargetsPerProject.

CQ8.evidence: Shared changes additive only (new DTOs + INV-OB constants); no existing contract removed/renamed.

Q1.reasoning: Transactional create/update; FOR SHARE row-lock on data_lists before writes blocks a concurrent soft-delete until commit; validating INSERT JOIN deleted_at IS NULL + count check; rollback on mismatch; composite FK cross-tenant backstop.

Q2.reasoning: TenantContext.TenantId in every query + UserId->created_by; ProjectsOptions.Allowed gate; all repo queries tenant_id-filtered.

Q3.reasoning: DELETE -> ArchiveAsync soft-delete (status='archived'+archived_at); list/detail exclude archived; active-name partial-unique frees name.

Q4.reasoning: No cxapi config/run-counter writes, no allowlist, P0-3 gate + bulk engine untouched; cxapi columns deferred to PR-4.

Q5.reasoning: Typed NpgsqlException only; INV-OB-071 doc now states commit-ambiguity + retry-safe-via-idempotency (consistent with code); COUNT(*) cast to ::int.
